title: N--OHMSETT FUNCTIONAL CLASSROOM UPGRADE
description: !!UPDATE AS OF 11/25/2026 - Amendment 1 posted to provide responses to vendor questions to date and provide additional information.  See attachments section with files uploaded on 11/25/2026!!  The Department of the Interior is soliciting quotations from eligible SBA 8(a) participants for a commercial requirement to furnish, deliver, install, and configure a flexible training/classroom solution at the Ohmsett Facility in Leonardo, New Jersey.  Interested quoters should review all attached solicitation documents, including the Request for Quotation (RFQ), Statement of Work (SOW), floor plan, and 2 video walkthroughs.
